name: designer-skills
title_zh: 把设计师的整套工作流打包成可复用的技能
tagline_zh: 从调研到交付，设计师的隐性决策链被拆成一个个可调用的技能。装完像多了个随时在线的设计搭档，不用再靠猜。
tagline_en: Turn a designer's hidden decision chain into callable skills. Install it and get a design partner who's always.
why_zh: 不是单点技巧，而是把调研、构思、评审、交付的完整链路拆成技能，每个环节都有可追溯的产出物。
why_en: Not isolated tricks—it decomposes the full design loop into skills with traceable outputs, so you can plug them into your own.
limit_zh: 依赖 Figma API 和本地 Node 环境；只覆盖 UI/UX 设计域，不碰品牌、动效或前端代码。
limit_en: Requires Figma API + local Node. UI/UX only—no brand, motion, or frontend code. Output ends at specs, not runnable pages.
